title: Skill Points
text: Skill Points are shared by the whole party. Basic ATK restores 1, Skills consume 1. You can hold up to 5.

title: Action Value
text: Turn order is decided by Action Value: 10000 / SPD. Faster units act more often, and Action Advance lets an ally act sooner.

title: Weakness Break
text: Attack with an element the enemy is weak to in order to deplete its Toughness. A broken enemy is delayed and suffers an element-specific effect.

title: Ultimates
text: When a character's Energy is full, their Ultimate can be used at any time, even during an enemy's turn.

title: Light Cones
text: A Light Cone's passive only activates when the wearer walks the same Path. Superimpose duplicates to strengthen it up to S5.

title: Relics
text: Equip four Cavern Relics and two Planar Ornaments. Matching sets grant 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses.

title: Techniques
text: Techniques consume Technique Points in the overworld and grant an advantage at the start of the next battle.
